notes.title: SUX 1.1 Hotfix 1 Update!
notes.content:
A couple quick fixes to tag along with this week's 1.1 update:

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Buffered grabs executed after holdable flip tricks now work as expected
[*] Rider no longer jumps at the start of a round after player retries
[*] Changed playlist toggle screen font to one without character rendering issues
[/list]

notes.title: SUX 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Thanks to [b]YOU[/b] we are now VERY POSITIVE on Steam! Tell your friends to get in the action during this week's Planes, Trains, and Automobiles Festival while we're on sale!

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]

[list]
[*] Hot new music track "I don't think much at all" by Emma Goldman!
[*] Customizable music playlist! Toggle individual tracks on and off.  
[*] New cheat codes!
[*] Engine version upgrade, Unity 2018 -> Unity 2022. [i]For reasons[/i].
[/list]


[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Track ID no longer showing on pause screen when no music is playing.
[*] Phone UI no longer invisible on some older devices. 
[*] Increased volume of some gameplay sounds mixed too quietly.  
[*] Menu navigation now wraps around in tutorial pause screen.
[*] Music tracks now continue playing after current track is finished while in Free Ride mode.
[*] Music no longer skips tracks more than once when advancing to the next track.  
[*] Game complete SMS message now sends when expected.
[*] Goal completion tracking percentage now properly reflects game progress.  
[*] Corrected some menus UI alignment and scaling issues.  
[*] Cancel button now closes pause screen.
[*] Cancel button now correctly navigates back in menus as expected.  
[*] Initiating a holdable trick during footplant-prepare animation no longer causes sticky points-tallying on other, non-holdable tricks.
[*] Some objects that appeared invisible behind transparent textures are now visible.
[/list]

notes.title: SUX 1.0.3 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]SUX UPDATE FOR A SMOOTHER RIDE[/h1]

[b]Update 1.0.3 addresses:[/b]

[list]
[*] Beating the game with the second half of playable characters caused problems that prevented the game completion goals, rewards, and messages from firing and saving correctly. This should now be working as intended.
[*] In-progress gap state were not reset when retrying a round. This has been fixed.
[*] A grindable railing consistently lead players out of bounds in the Water Treatment Plant level. Now keeping you in bounds!
[*] Saved data was falsely flagged as "out of date" and being deleted. Sorry for the inconvenience, this has now been fixed!
[/list]
[b]Known Issue:[/b]

[list]
[*] Some users continue to have issues with transparent menus that are too hard to read. 
[/list]
If you're experiencing the above issue, please file a bug report. Please include your email address so we can work with you on getting a fix! Copy this link and put it in your browser's URL bar:

[code]https://form.asana.com/?k=0yscRMz-OlVqJco6EJJLoQ&d=1200830748187382[/code]

notes.title: SUX 1.0.2 Update!
notes.content:
Quick update to fix some small issues

Update 1.0.2 addresses:
[list]
[*]Progress % displaying more than 100% per rider in some cases
[*]Rider Completion SMS messages sometimes failing to send
[*]Some rider names overlapping other UI elements in SMS Message screen
[*]One rider was missing Game Start and Game Complete SMS Message content
[/list]
Also seeks to address:
[list]
[*]Menus still barely visible on some devices
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*]Refresh rate display option does not function correctly
[*]Game does not function as expected on high refresh rate monitors
[*]Mouse cursor visible in game
[/list]

notes.title: SUX 1.0.1 Update!
notes.content:
[h1] THANK YOU FOR THE BIG LAUNCH![/h1]

We're so stoked by your incredible response since launching and this ride is only getting started! We're going to take a break for [url=https://sux.gammaspace.ca]the release party happening in Vancouver on June 28[/url], but before we go, we're pushing out a small update.

[b]Update 1.0.1 addresses:[/b]

[list]
[*] Rider becomes stuck and bugged when entering credits before loading a game.
[*] The gaps menu option was visible in the credits, which caused a soft-lock when selected. 
[*] Rider becomes stuck and bugged if holding coast before round starts.
[*] Menus barely visible on some devices.
[/list]

Additionally, if you've had issues getting your game started on your Steam Deck, this should now be corrected.
